title: Lesson 6
paragraph: 再生可能エネルギーと建物

words.meaning: a device that converts sunlight into electrical energy
words.example: Each solar panel supplies electricity to the building.
words.usageNote: ここでは発電用パネルです。太陽熱で水を温める装置とは区別します。

words.meaning: a machine that uses wind to turn blades and generate electricity
words.example: The wind turbine operates on the hill above the town.

sentencePractice.prompt: Wind turns the blades of a machine that generates electricity. The machine is a ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Wind-driven rotating blades identify a wind turbine; sunlight conversion and heat movement describe different devices.

words.meaning: electricity generated by using the movement of water
words.example: The region produces hydropower from water released through turbines.

words.meaning: organic material from plants or animals used as a source of energy
words.example: The facility uses plant waste as biomass for fuel.
words.usageNote: ここではエネルギー資源の意味。生物学では生物量を表すこともあります。

words.meaning: the connected system that carries electrical power from suppliers to users
words.example: The new wind farm supplies power to the electricity grid.

words.meaning: a system that keeps electrical energy in batteries for later use
words.japaneseMeaning: 蓄電池によるエネルギー貯蔵
words.example: Battery storage can supply power after sunset.

words.meaning: material or a system used to reduce heat passing into or out of a building
words.example: Better insulation reduces heat loss in winter.

words.meaning: a device that uses energy to move heat from one place to another for heating or cooling
words.example: The heat pump draws heat from outside air to warm the building.

sentencePractice.prompt: The device uses energy to move heat from outdoor air into the building. It is a ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Transferring heat between locations identifies a heat pump; the other devices generate electricity from sunlight or wind.

words.meaning: the amount of energy that users need or seek to use over a period
words.example: Energy demand rises when many buildings need heating.

words.meaning: the highest level of energy or power use during a specified period
words.japaneseMeaning: ピーク需要・最大需要
words.example: The operator prepares extra capacity for peak demand.
